scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: node "$npm_execpath" run typecheck && node "$npm_execpath" -r --filter "!./artifacts/mockup-sandbox" --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: node "$npm_execpath" run typecheck:libs && node "$npm_execpath" -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
